site.name: PERTH / BULLSBROOK / SYDNEY
site.desc: Five Australians and one New Zealander landed at RAAF Base Pearce near Perth 14 May and transported to Bullsbrook quarantine facility for mandatory three-week quarantine per AP 14 May; all tested negative on arrival but further health assessments under way. Health Minister Mark Butler announced one of the world's strictest quarantine measures; facility originally stood up during COVID-19 in 2022.

site.name: M/V HONDIUS
site.desc: WHO confirmed 11 cases (9 confirmed, 2 suspected) and 3 deaths as of 13 May; Andes virus identified. Vessel evacuated at Granadilla de Abona with 87 passengers and 35 crew transported to Canary Islands; en route Rotterdam with skeleton crew of 30 + Dutch nurse for full disinfection. Arctic voyage schedule under review.

site.name: USHUAIA / ARGENTINA ROUTE
site.desc: Index case (Dutch male, 70, died 11 Apr) took 4-month road trip 27 Nov 2025–1 Apr 2026 through Chile, Uruguay, Argentina before boarding; Dutch couple believed to have contracted virus during South America visit pre-boarding per AP 13 May. Argentine health ministry published detailed route map 06 May; Malbrán Institute trapping/testing rodents along route.

site.name: PARIS / LE BOURGET

French government mandated 42-day quarantine decree with contact tracing identifying 22 potential cases across international flights.
